verbs.description: Open the invite sheet on a workspace: where a link into it is made, the part it brings someone in at picked and the links that still work taken back. An app shares what it shows by asking this, so it offers the one sheet the bar's invite button opens.
verbs.label: Invite people

verbs.description: Show how an agent or another computer connects as the person: the setup their own card's "Connect an agent or computer" opens. An app that lists what acts as them offers adding to it this way.
verbs.label: Connect an agent or computer

verbs.description: Show how a new device of the person's joins them: Settings' devices page, where "Add a device" prints the ticket it logs in with. An app that lists what acts as the person offers adding to it this way.
verbs.label: Add a device

verbs.description: Open what a `tilo://open#…` link names: the app that keeps it shows it, started first when no window of it does. An app that shows a link opens it this way, whoever it was copied from.
verbs.label: Open a link

verbs.description: Cancel the invitation `invite` of a workspace: its link admits nobody from now on
verbs.label: Cancel invitation

types.doc: One of the person's workspaces elsewhere, which this device does not hold.
types.name: Elsewhere

types.doc: The account with one host running the person's workspaces.
types.name: Host
